summary: This directory provides the testing infrastructure and validation suites for core security mechanisms. It ensures that path-related security logic and access boundaries are correctly enforced and resilient against unauthorized filesystem access.
responsibilities: Verify the correctness of security-related path logic
Validate security constraints and access rules for application paths
Execute automated test suites for security components
relationships: Security validation logic is verified through automated tests to ensure path integrity.
Test suites define the expected behavior for security constraints applied to application paths.
designDecisions: Colocation of test files with their corresponding security logic
Use of specialized testing frameworks for verification of security requirements
